feat(argon2): switch backend to argon2-rust (#1188)

* feat(argon2): switch backend to argon2-rust

Replace RustCrypto argon2 with argon2-rust 1.0.0 from crates.io.
Keep the public JS API. Verify accepts node-argon2 PHC param order
and associatedData. The bench pins the same raw params, salt, and
tag across implementations.

* fix(argon2): keep Node 22 tests and bound verify threads

Skip the node:crypto.argon2Sync comparison on runtimes that lack it.
Cap worker threads at available parallelism so a PHC p= value cannot
spawn one OS thread per lane. Allocate tag buffers with try_reserve
instead of vec! so a huge outputLen is a JS error, not a process abort.

* fix(argon2): skip node-argon2 interop when its native addon is missing

node-argon2 0.45 has no darwin-x64 prebuild. Intel macOS CI runs x64
Node on an ARM host, so a static import crashed the whole spec file.

* test(argon2): compare against node:crypto argon2

Drop the node-argon2 native addon from tests. Interop uses the
builtin KDF, which is available on every CI host that has it.

perf(argon2): simdutf8, crate PHC decode, argon2-rust 1.1 (#1189)

* perf(argon2): validate UTF-8 with simdutf8 before owning the string

Check the JS byte slice with simdutf8, then build String via
from_utf8_unchecked so from_utf8 does not walk the bytes again.

* perf(argon2): decode PHC Base64 with a LUT instead of the engine

Salt and tag fields are tens of bytes. A 256-entry table plus leftover-bit
checks beats the generic base64 crate, and on aarch64 argon2-rust's SIMD
would not even run for a 16-byte salt.

* perf(argon2): decode PHC fields with argon2-rust SIMD Base64

Use the new encode_base64/decode_base64 entry points. decode_phc still
owns param order and data=. Temporarily depends on the local
argon2-rust tree until 1.1.0 is on crates.io.

* feat(argon2): consume argon2-rust 1.1 PHC APIs

Drop the local PHC parser, encoder, and compare. Hash and verify go
through hash_encoded_with_ad, decode_phc, and verify_with_ad.
Require argon2-rust 1.1 from crates.io; the sibling path dep is gone.
